decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and drawing Nos. 869.1, 2, 3, 4 Received 25 February 2009 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southern or northern walls of the extension hereby approved, without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The flank of the side wall located on the south eastern side boundary shall be a light coloured render to match the render of the ground floor of the dwelling.
Condition : 7 - Suitable protection measures shall be erected during construction to protect the tree within the rear garden of the subject site from equipment, machinery and the development.
description: Erection of a side and rear two storey extension to lower ground and upper ground floors
